tasks.prompt:
/sl-drift-reconcile

Run scheduled GitOps and cluster drift reconciliation for #partner-signal-loom.
1. Verify Flux Kustomization and ResourceSet statuses.
2. Assert JSON6902 patch indexes in tenants/local/kustomization.yaml target OCIRepositories.
3. Scan for unresolved ${VAR} tokens in applied cluster manifests.
4. Reconcile if safe; report brief with any manual override drift.

/sl-portforward-supervisor

Supervise Signal Loom ingress, durable port-forwarding, and in-pod backend proxies.
1. Verify systemd unit signalloom-portforward.service status.
2. Probe http://localhost:5173/ and Envoy Gateway https://localhost:18443/.
3. Auto-recover broken SPDY streams after pod rollouts.
4. Execute in-pod curl check against /fleet-api/v1/fleet/topology and /api/v1/health.

/sl-silent-failure-audit

Execute scheduled audit of the 17 Signal Loom silent failure invariants.
1. Assert CRI image layers present via crictl (not containerd ctr metadata).
2. Verify PostgreSQL audit_events constraint permits all AST-emitted dotted names.
3. Verify zero collisions between nginx proxy locations and React Router App.tsx routes.
4. Verify POOL_IMPORTERS connection pool binding invariant.
5. Scan BATS test outputs for silent # skip masks.

/sl-containment-guard

Enforce agent stun, containment, and GitOps suspension integrity.
1. Enforce kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/reconcile: disabled on all stunned agent deployments.
2. Verify H1 forensic preservation contract (liveness probe kill suppression).
3. Audit Fleet Manager in-memory DAG state sync with GET /api/v1/fleet/topology.
4. Assert telemetry monitor agent (agent-monitor) immunity.

/sl-pyramid-verify

Execute the offline test pyramid and contract drift verification.
1. Run make docs-lint across all documentation.
2. Run make test-all-offline (Go unit tests, Vitest suites, Python API tests).
3. Verify zero schema drift between initdb migrations and discovery-portal-bootstrap.sql.
4. Assert empirical mutation test falsifiability.

/sl-worktree-governor

Govern multi-agent worktrees and Kanban controller leases.
1. Scan all worktrees under ~/src/.worktrees/ and ~/.cline/worktrees/.
2. Isolate and preserve worktrees with uncommitted files or unpushed commits.
3. Audit Kanban controller leases via kanban-check.sh doctor --repo .
4. Identify safe merge-complete candidates for pruning.

/sl-eap-evidence-sweep

Audit compliance and supply chain evidence for EAP design partners.
1. Verify Cosign signatures, SLSA provenance, and SPDX SBOMs in docs/signalloom/evidence/.
2. Audit PostgreSQL audit_events continuous non-zero row growth.
3. Validate NetAssert network policy boundary proofs.
4. Deliver verified evidence pack ledger for stakeholder and diligence review.

/sl-drift-sweep

Run two-axis codebase drift, Fowler code-smell, and proposal-sprawl sweep for #partner-signal-loom.
1. Run Tools/drift-sweep.sh to evaluate Axis A (Standards & Fowler Code Smells) and Axis B (Spec & Proposal Fidelity).
2. By default (PAUSE_FOR_APPROVAL), present the Two-Axis Report and Cleanup Job Manifest and pause for user sign-off.
3. When invoked with --auto or /goal, execute Phases 2-4 in isolated worktrees with fail->fix mutation proofs and rebase/merge onto the active branch.
